decisions.V1_env: targets/chain/decide/collect reactot; check/work/conf/dft = D1 run env (autodE 1.4.5, RDKit 2024.3.2, xtb 6.7.1, ORCA 6.1.1, OpenMPI 4.1.8f)
decisions.V2_targets: (a) dev > 0.5; (b) dipolarophile keys with a D / Dp row; constrained excluded; (c) one default_rng(20261023): 10 dipolarophiles then 10 dipoles from the sorted rest
decisions.V3_trial: cyclooctyne + 3,3-dimethylcyclooctyne + 8 of sorted (a) with a fresh default_rng(20261023)
decisions.V4_anchor: lowest label reference with D1-HF orig + hf inputs; all structures in its atom order; its inputs = templates
decisions.V5_forms: D1 references deduped (dE < 0.05 or RMSD < 0.1) = forms, kept with D1 values, xTB-relaxed into the dedupe pool first; DFT on the 5 lowest new search conformers
decisions.V6_etkdg: ETKDGv3 defaults, randomSeed 20261023, 300, no pre-pruning, with H
decisions.V7_rr: autodE get_simanl_conformer x 300 round robin over the forms + autodE prunes; seeded RandomState(20261023+n)
decisions.V8_xtb: --opt tight --alpb water --gfn 2 --chrg q --uhf 0; graph iso to anchor; stereo3d_sig = the key's signature (unique D1 signature, else the Q E_min source's); not checkable -> molecule failed (no V replacement)
decisions.V9_dft_text: autodE ORCA text reproduced byte for byte (checked on D1 run inputs); ORCA run directly
decisions.V10_imag: any freq < 0 -> one 1.0 A displacement + Opt/Freq; any freq < 0 after that = failure 'imag' (spec V-3); the -50 cm-1 (config extra_imag_tol_cm) count is a reported sensitivity only
decisions.V11_sp: label SP = template with coordinates replaced (checked), no retry; HF route A == route B, D1-HF retry rule; valid conformer = both SPs ok; every ORCA output = 6.1.1 (487d211c) or STOP
decisions.V12_repro: trial anchors rerun unchanged: |dE| <= 0.05 kcal/mol vs label and labels_d1_hf, else STOP
decisions.V13_v4: replace iff E_min(Q) - E_V > 0.05; Q-4/Q-5 via refs_q with tag cr2; gates V-a, V-c, V-e added
decisions.V14_hf_refs: HF of final references: own / Q source / V SP -> $LAD/refs_cr2.parquet
decisions.V15_cost: estimate = max(mean x N, n_atoms^3 scaling) of allocated core-h; <= 5000 -> go
decisions.V16_layout: trial 2 tasks %2; main K tasks (K = --max-run, default 4), throttle min(K, 4 - other LADDER tasks); 8 CPUs 48G; chain launcher resubmits; round limit (main from the estimate) -> STOP when hit
decisions.V18_lock: per-molecule O_EXCL lock with the SLURM job id; held by a live job -> skipped; dead owner -> taken over
decisions.V19_shared_writes: check.json / STOP written with a per-process temporary name (parallel array tasks)
decisions.V20_mpirun: check requires mpirun on PATH under $MPI_ROOT

found.rr_tool: autodE 1.4.5 conf_gen.get_simanl_conformer (make_reference.coley_port step 4; autodE RR conformer generator) + Conformers.prune_on_energy(e_tol=1e-10), prune_on_rmsd() (0.3 A)
found.dft_level: autodE opt / hess keywords of the D1 run (ts_result.json 'keywords'): 'Opt' Functional(B3LYP) ResolutionOfIdentity(rijcosx) DispersionCorrection(D3BJ) BasisSet(def2-SVP) 'def2/J' EffectiveCorePotential(def2-ECP) | 'Freq' Functional(B3LYP) ResolutionOfIdentity(rijcosx) DispersionCorrection(D3BJ) BasisSet(def2-SVP) 'def2/J' EffectiveCorePotential(def2-ECP)
found.orca_text: autode/wrappers/ORCA.py generate_input_for: '!' words, %cpcm smd block, %output / %scf / Hirshfeld, '% maxcore' 3000, %pal nprocs 8, '*xyz q m' with '{:<3} {:^12.8f} x3' lines
found.label_inputs: $HF/inputs/<job>/orig/frag{k}_rel.inp (D1-HF prep.py byte copies of the archive sp/*.inp)
